title: Oncology / Cancer Genetics
text: Patients with hereditary nonpolyposis colorectal cancer and breast cancer show frequent germline mutations. In our cohort, malignant melanoma and ovarian cancer were also detected with high penetrance.

title: Cardiology & Metabolic
text: Severe hypertension and type 2 diabetes mellitus significantly elevate the long-term risk of myocardial infarction, heart failure, and chronic renal failure in geriatric cohorts.

title: Neurology & Neurogenetics
text: Familial Alzheimer disease and Huntington disease involve progressive neurodegeneration. Ataxia-telangiectasia was diagnosed following acute episodes of cerebellar atrophy and ocular telangiectasia.

title: Infectious & Respiratory
text: Severe acute respiratory syndrome caused by COVID-19 frequently leads to bacterial pneumonia, sepsis, and high fever in immunocompromised patients with pre-existing asthma.
